title: Crossformer: Hierarchical cross-dimension attention recovers a transformer lead on ETTh1, Electricity, Traffic
abstract: We study long-horizon multivariate forecasting using Crossformer, a cross-dimension transformer with hierarchical encoder. On ETTh1, Electricity, Traffic, at horizon 336, Hierarchical cross-dimension attention recovers a transformer lead on ETTh1, Electricity, Traffic. Crossformer outperforms DLinear by 21% MSE on ETTh1 at horizon 336. We discuss two limitations: Reported gains use a single held-out split; results across seeds vary by more than the headline MSE difference. Computational cost is reported for a single input length; scaling behaviour is not measured. Future work should address studying performance under explicit train/test distribution shift. and pretraining on a mixture of datasets to test transfer. [SEED-FIXTURE — not a real publication].
